name: codeshift-backend
description: A production-grade, secure RESTful API for a Developer Assessment Platform built with Node.js, TypeScript, Express, and PostgreSQL using Prisma ORM. Features robust role-based access control (RBAC) for Admins, Recruiters, and Candidates, automated code submission validation frameworks, GCP Social Login, real payment gateway integration (Stripe/bKash/SSLCommerz), secure data parsing using Zod, and optimized caching via Redis.
author: Shorabul Hoque shorabulhoque@yahoo.com
